dataset: HRA Female Colonic and Renal Continuation
attribution: Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein (2023), 3D Reference Organ Set for Female v1.5, HuBMAP / Human Reference Atlas. DOI: 10.48539/HBM352.BTSQ.586. CC BY 4.0.
modifications: Selected previously unmounted original female colonic, renal and associated vascular meshes from the same official united GLB; original positions, topology and node identities retained; neutral material for app coloring; normalized normals and 18-bit Draco position quantization. The conflicting inferior mesenteric vein label/ontology is cleared in normalized metadata while raw source values remain available. No inferred anatomy, no inter-source registration.

coordinates.sourceToApp: Identity: original GLB POSITION coordinates are retained; all source nodes have no matrix/TRS transforms. Common relative positions are inherited from one united HRA female reference model.
coordinates.orientationEvidence: Left ovary has greater X than right ovary; urinary bladder is anterior (+Z) to rectum/sacrum; fundus is superior (+Y) to cervix/vagina. Source GLB is Y-up, metre convention. No per-organ translation, scale, rotation or registration has been applied.

limitations: A source-coherent colonic and renal continuation, not a complete female body.
Existing pelvic, upper-abdominal and cardiac mesh IDs are excluded; sigmoid colon and rectum remain in the original pelvic subset.
Renal papillae, pyramids and columns are source surface subdivisions; they are not separate organs or proof of full intrarenal arterial distribution.

The inferior mesenteric vein has a copied superior mesenteric artery label and ontology. Display name follows its original vein node, vein parent and Vein_mat; normalized conflicting ontology fields are cleared.
The united reference model combines curated reference organs and does not represent one patient segmentation.
No pelvic nerve or external genital mesh is supplied by this source.

coverage.colon: source-labeled ascending, transverse, descending, flexures, caecum, appendix, ileocecal valve; preinstalled sigmoid and rectum excluded
coverage.kidneys: paired capsules, cortex, hilum and source-labeled internal subdivisions
coverage.mesentericVessels: source-labeled colic arterial and venous structures; source continuity not guaranteed
